## Project identity

M3 reduces redundant compute, allocation, retained state, rediscovery, and
repeated transformation while preserving required observable contracts.

M3Index is the indexed/precomputation substrate for canonical semantic facts,
content/logic/structural identity, direct addressing, reusable search/index
structures, compact representations, reusable precomputation, and proof
evidence.

M3Scale is the execution discipline around inventory, bounded multi-pass
transformation, deterministic fan-out, ordered verification, and promotion of
qualified state.

These descriptions establish project identity and provenance; they do not make
abstract ideas, algorithms, mathematical principles, methods of operation,
systems, procedures, facts, or independently developed implementations
copyright property.
